transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me today. I hope I'm not taking up too much of your time. 

I guess I came in because... well, I want to make sure I'm doing the right thing. It's probably nothing major, but I just always feel like I've got this... this motor running inside me all day. It's not like I mean to be a bother to anyone, I just have a lot of energy, you know? But if I have to sit still for a bit, like at church, or out in the waiting room here at the clinic, or even just sitting around at home, I start feeling kind of trapped. I just end up having to get up or do something. 

Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it okay.
How long have you felt like you have this motor running inside you?

Well, I guess I've always been a pretty energetic guy, which is a good thing, right? But... it's really felt this hard to manage for, oh, maybe about two years and two months now. 

It kind of started feeling more like a problem right around the time my older relative's health changed, and I had to step up and take on a lot more responsibilities at home to help out. I really don't mind helping, I want to do my part, but that's just when I noticed this... feeling getting stronger. Is it normal to feel a bit more restless when you have a lot on your plate? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Aside from feeling restless, do you find yourself constantly worrying about many different things in your day-to-day life?

Worrying? Well, um... no, I don't think so. I mean, I want to do a good job taking care of things at home, sure. Anybody would care about that, right? But I wouldn't say I'm constantly worrying about a whole bunch of different things. 

It's not like my mind is scared or, you know, stressing over everything all day. It's really just... my body wanting to move all the time. I hope that's an okay answer? I just don't want to give you the wrong idea and make you think I'm some kind of nervous wreck, because I'm really not. I just... I just have a lot of physical energy. Is that helpful?
Do you also struggle with keeping your attention on tasks, being organized, or getting easily distracted?

Well, um... I really try my best to pay attention, I promise I do. I want to be helpful and organized for everyone. But, I guess... sometimes my mind just kind of wanders a little bit? 

Like, when folks are talking through things we need to do—you know, figuring out ride times for appointments, going over the pantry lists for the week, or even just discussing church plans—I always start out listening really good. I'm right there with them. But then... I don't know, it just slips off somewhere else. And then I realize I missed pieces of what they were saying, pieces I really needed to hear to do a good job. 

It makes me feel awful because I don't want them to think I don't care. I do care, very much! It's just hard to keep my focus locked in sometimes. Is that... is that the kind of thing you're asking about? I hope I'm not making it sound worse than it is, I really am trying my hardest to stay on top of things.
